status: chat-1 is the target and the reference for this task only (D61); learned scores are out of fold by JD; the human check is exploratory

rules.bar: a candidate passes when its paired Recall@10 delta against X2's order (total) is >= +0.05 and the CI's lower end is above 0
rules.best: the candidate with the highest out-of-fold Recall@10 (total) among S1, L1, L2, R3, R1, R2, L3; a tie (6 dp) goes to the earlier, cheaper one. Chosen on the same figures it is then reported with: mildly optimistic (owner, 18 Oct 2026)
rules.ablations: of the better of L1 and L2 on Recall@10 (total), ties to L1: without tfidf_scaled, without role_match, without sbert; diagnostic, never 'best'
rules.features: F12 computed on each JD's 500-CV pool frame (tfidf_scaled min-max over the pool, as S1 sees it), then the chat pairs' rows
rules.constraints: L1 non-negative and L2 monotone increasing on the 8 match signals; the 4 descriptors (log_jd_concepts, log_cv_concepts, exp_gap, exp_known) free
rules.end_to_end: stage 1 = S1's passed set (P >= 0.5, owner 18 Oct 2026); reference = chat's top 10 over all chat-scored CVs of the JD, tie-aware; fewer than 10 returned counts the misses
rules.human_check: exploratory: judged CVs inside the shortlists, per-JD AUC on the final label and pairwise on yc's grades, full and llm_free
rules.fixed: 18 Oct 2026, in this module, before its first run
